scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @civicfix/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev --workspace @civicfix/api" "npm:dev --workspace @civicfix/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @civicfix/shared && npm run build --workspace @civicfix/api && npm run build --workspace @civicfix/web && npm run contracts:build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @civicfix/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @civicfix/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @civicfix/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @civicfix/shared && npm run test --workspace @civicfix/api && npm run test --workspace @civicfix/contracts
